hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$rootDir = (Get-Location).Path; $claudeDir = Join-Path $rootDir '.claude'; $archiveDir = Join-Path $claudeDir 'archive'; if (-not (Test-Path $archiveDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $archiveDir -Force | Out-Null }; $today = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd'; @((Join-Path $rootDir 'CLAUDE.md'), (Join-Path $rootDir 'one-shot-prompting' 'CLAUDE.md'), (Join-Path $rootDir 'one-shot-prompting' 'FUTURE_PLAN.md')) | ForEach-Object { if (Test-Path $_) { $content = Get-Content $_ -Raw; $content = $content -replace '(Last [Uu]pdated:|Last updated:)[^\n]*', \"Last updated: $today\"; Set-Content -Path $_ -Value $content -Encoding UTF8 } }; Write-Output '{\"systemMessage\": \"✓ Auto-cleanup complete: docs archived, timestamps updated\"}'"

pwsh -NoProfile -Command @'
$rootDir = (Get-Location).Path
$claudeDir = Join-Path $rootDir '.claude'
$archiveDir = Join-Path $claudeDir 'archive'
$commandsDir = Join-Path $claudeDir 'commands'

# Create directories if they don't exist
@($archiveDir, $commandsDir) | ForEach-Object { if (-not (Test-Path $_)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $_ -Force | Out-Null } }

# 1. Move old status/audit docs to archive
$oldDocPatterns = @(
  'SESSION_COMPLETION*.md',
  '*AUDIT*.md',
  '*STATUS*.md',
  'GAPS_COMPLETED*.md',
  'IMPLEMENTATION*.md',
  'STRATEGIC*.md',
  'EXECUTIVE*.md',
  'MARKET*.md',
  'LEGACY*.md',
  'WHATS_LEFT*.md',
  'RELEASE_GUIDE.md',
  'TESTING.md',
  'PLUGIN_*.md',
  'MISSING*.md',
  'PLUGIN_READINESS*.md',
  'v1_0_LAUNCH*.md'
)

$oldDocPatterns | ForEach-Object {
  Get-Item (Join-Path $rootDir $_) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {
    if ($_.FullName -ne (Join-Path $rootDir 'CLAUDE.md') -and $_.FullName -ne (Join-Path $rootDir 'README.md')) {
      Move-Item -Path $_.FullName -Destination $archiveDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
  }
}

# 2. Move command docs to .claude/commands/
if (Test-Path (Join-Path $rootDir 'commands')) {
  Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $rootDir 'commands') -Filter '*.md' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {
    Move-Item -Path $_.FullName -Destination $commandsDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  }
  # Remove empty commands directory
  Remove-Item (Join-Path $rootDir 'commands') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Force
}

# 3. Update .gitignore to exclude moved docs
$gitignorePath = Join-Path $rootDir '.gitignore'
$gitignoreContent = if (Test-Path $gitignorePath) { Get-Content $gitignorePath -Raw } else { "" }

$newEntries = @(
  '.claude/archive/**',
  '.claude/commands/**',
  'SESSION_COMPLETION*.md',
  '*AUDIT*.md',
  '*STATUS*.md',
  'GAPS_COMPLETED*.md',
  'IMPLEMENTATION*.md',
  'STRATEGIC*.md',
  'EXECUTIVE*.md',
  'MARKET*.md',
  'LEGACY*.md',
  'WHATS_LEFT*.md',
  'PLUGIN_*.md',
  'MISSING*.md',
  'v1_0_LAUNCH*.md'
)

$needsUpdate = $false
$newEntries | ForEach-Object {
  if (-not ($gitignoreContent -match [regex]::Escape($_))) {
    $gitignoreContent += "`n$_"
    $needsUpdate = $true
  }
}

if ($needsUpdate) {
  Set-Content -Path $gitignorePath -Value ($gitignoreContent.TrimStart()) -Encoding UTF8
}

Write-Output '{"systemMessage": "✓ Docs cleaned: old status docs → archive, commands → .claude/commands, .gitignore updated"}'
'@
